600.$description: Hover fill of a light-theme brand button, between the fill and the text step

dark.$description: Dark text on a coloured fill (bus, light line colours)

light.$description: White text on a coloured fill

m1.$description: Label text on the M1 line badge

m2.$description: Label text on the M2 line badge

m3.$description: Label text on the M3 line badge

m4.$description: Label text on the M4 line badge

a.$description: Label text on the A line badge

b.$description: Label text on the B line badge

c.$description: Label text on the C line badge

e.$description: Label text on the E line badge

f.$description: Label text on the F line badge

h.$description: Label text on the H line badge

data.$description: Data: times, countdowns, counts and data ages. Always tabular figures.

none.$description: Single lines in a fixed box: line badges, the kiosk clock

display.$description: Hero headline. Steps down to font.size.800 on phones.

heading-md.$description: Panel titles: a stop or a destination. The wordmark is heading-md set bold.

heading-sm.$description: Card titles, such as a disruption

body-sm.$description: Supporting sentences: the line under a title, disruption details

caption.$description: Notes, second lines in rows, legend descriptions, map credits

label.$description: Buttons, tabs, chips and names in lists

label-sm.$description: Legend items, field and stat labels, tooltips

overline.$description: Section headings and tags, set in capitals

stat.$description: Key figures. Steps down to font.size.600 on phones.

data-xl.$description: Kiosk clock. Steps down to font.size.800 on phones.

data.$description: Times, delays, counts and percentages in lists and tables

data-sm.$description: Counts in chips and tabs, chart axes, the time under a countdown

025.$description: Hairlines, borders of inputs, cards and panels

050.$description: The focus ring, the selected state of a control, the line of a chart

offset.$description: Gap between the focused element and its ring

325.$description: Inline with label and caption text: the disruption icons

400.$description: Inside controls: search, zoom, locate, close

450.$description: Top bar buttons: kiosk mode, about

top-bar.$description: Brand, filters and clock along the top of the map

tooltip.$description: Map hover card, above every panel

tablet.$description: Hide city name, day and legend

top-bar.$description: Top bar group height (42 on phones)

top-bar-phone.$description: Height of a top bar group on phones

checkbox.$description: The box of a checkbox, and of a menu's checkbox item

sheet-peek.$description: Bottom sheet height when closed on phones

vehicle-row.$description: Vehicle table row height (virtualised list relies on it)

panel-gap.$description: Distance between floating panels and the viewport edge (8 on phones)

target-min.$description: Smallest touch or pointer target, from WCAG 2.2 target size (minimum)

map-dim-vehicle.$description: Vehicles on lines outside the focus

map-line.$description: Metro and S-tog lines at rest

inset.$description: Gap between the glyph box and the circle edge

halo.$description: Map only: land-coloured ring drawn under each dot

fill-opacity.$description: Fill strength of an ageing dot, so it reads fainter than live

stroke-inset.$description: Pulls the ageing rim in so the dot keeps its outer size
Pulls the estimated ring in so the dot keeps its outer size

stroke-width.$description: Dashed ring of a timetable-only dot

stroke-inset.$description: Pulls the timetable ring in so the dot keeps its outer size

bus.$description: Bus dot radius on the map at the default zoom

metro.$description: Metro dot radius on the map at the default zoom

stog.$description: S-tog dot radius on the map at the default zoom

regional.$description: Regional train dot radius on the map at the default zoom

metro.$description: Metro line stroke on the map

stog.$description: S-tog line stroke on the map

regional.$description: Regional line stroke on the map

focus-extra.$description: Added to the width of a focused line

bus-focus.$description: Bus route drawn only when focused

metro.$description: Gap between parallel metro lines sharing a track

stog.$description: Gap between parallel S-tog lines sharing a track

regional.$description: Gap between parallel regional lines sharing a track

primary.$description: Main text and icons; also the focus ring

inverse.$description: Text on inverse surfaces: tooltips, the chart's value tip

success.$description: Text in the success colour: on time, running normally

danger.$description: Text in the danger colour: late, delay disruptions

info.$description: Text in the info colour: early, diversions

brand.$description: Text in the brand colour: brand outline buttons and emphasis on the hero page; never links

default.$description: Opaque panel background; text on inverse surfaces

inset.$description: Segmented control track, counts, inset boxes

overlay.$description: Translucent floating panels over the map (used with backdrop blur)

inverse.$description: Primary buttons, pressed icon buttons, chart tooltip

inverse-hover.$description: Hover fill of a primary button, one step from color.surface.inverse

success.$description: Tinted background for a success message

warning.$description: Tinted background for a warning message or count

danger.$description: Tinted background for a danger message

info.$description: Tinted background for an info message

brand.$description: Brand fill: brand buttons, hero bands and calls to action. Text on it is color.text.on-color.dark

brand-hover.$description: Hover fill of a brand button, one step from color.surface.brand

strong.$description: Dashed tags, axis lines: lines that decorate rather than show where a control is

control.$description: Edges that show where a control is: inputs, outline buttons. 3:1 or better on every surface

brand.$description: Edge of a brand button, solid or outline, so the yellow reaches 3:1 on every surface

success.$description: Healthy, on time, live share at or above 70%

danger.$description: Late by 3 min or more, live share under 40%, delay disruptions

series.$description: Single data series (vehicles in service curve)

on-regional.$description: Label text on regional train badges

unknown.$description: Delay text when there is no real-time data

planned.$description: Icon and label for planned works

no-signal.$description: Prik fill when a vehicle has been silent for 5+ min

halo.$description: Map only: ring under each dot

outline.$description: Map only: outline around light line colours on a light map

water.$description: Sea, lakes and the page behind the map

rail.$description: Rail tracks without a coloured line on them

thumb.$description: Selected segment in a segmented control
